Note: Base language Lar (Larestani, lari1253, clade SW Iranian) is itself proposed in proposals.md. The dialect is the speech of the town of Lār as recorded there in 1977-78 (Foreword; Introduction §1, p. viii); informants are provenance, not dialects. Glottolog's dialect nucl1274 'Lari' is the town variety. Coordinates are the town of Lār (27°40′N 54°20′E), the elicitation locality.
Name: Lār
Location: Lār (old town), Lārestān, Fars province, Iran; elicitation locality
